name: VQA-RAD
intro: VQA-RAD是首个由临床医生手工构建的放射学视觉问答数据集，包含315张放射学图像和3515个临床医生自然提问，涵盖头部、胸部、腹部等多个解剖区域，旨在推动医学VQA技术发展。
build_method: MedPix均衡采样, 临床医生自然问答, 自由与模板改写, 人工验证分类
metric: Open-ended Accuracy, Closed-ended Accuracy, Overall Accuracy
build_method_en: Balanced MedPix sampling, clinician-authored natural Q/A, free-form and framed paraphrases, manual validation and categorization
eval_feature_en: The first radiology VQA dataset manually constructed by clinicians
intro_en: VQA-RAD is the first radiology visual question answering dataset manually constructed by clinicians, containing 315 radiology images and 3,515 natural questions from clinicians. It covers multiple anatomical regions including the head, chest, and abdomen, aiming to advance medical VQA technology.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with VQA-RAD Scientific Data paper, Methods and Technical Validation; official released dataset. VQA-RAD samples 315 head, chest, and abdominal radiology images from the open MedPix teaching archive. Clinicians write natural unguided questions they would ask a colleague and provide answers, then paraphrase questions in free-form and template forms. All image-question-answer pairs are manually validated and categorized by image, question, and answer type. The final set has 3,515 questions: 1,515 free-form, 733 rephrased, and 1,267 framed. Seven annotator pairs evaluate 75 percent of free-form and rephrased questions, producing mean agreement F1 of 0.85. Models answer open- and closed-ended questions from a single image, with accuracy reported separately and overall.
